topic.source_contract: Ancient woodland inventory, revised counties and planning standing advice

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government - Planning Data

facts.scope_guard: Inventory geometry is planning evidence and not title, exact tree extent or automatic refusal.
The national inventory remains primary only where a county has not been replaced by the revised completed-counties dataset.

facts.precedence: revised dataset takes precedence in completed counties
facts.scope_guard: Revised-county coverage is not silently extended to counties not yet completed.
Standing advice requires proposal-specific impact assessment and does not itself determine an application.
Guidance availability is not a current candidate overlay, survey or legal tree-status result.

scope_guards: The 44,373 inventory rows are not 44,373 development prohibitions or title parcels.
Ancient woodland inventory geometry is not an HMLR title or exact surveyed tree canopy.
Revised completed-county data takes precedence only where that county is included.
The legacy inventory remains relevant where a county revision is not completed.
Dataset absence is not evidence that no ancient woodland, ancient tree or veteran tree exists.
Ancient woodland, ancient trees and veteran trees remain distinct evidence types.
Standing advice and API availability do not prove an executed candidate assessment.
No score or promotion is written without exact current inventory, site survey, impact assessment, planning and title evidence.
